title: user-event: click and type like a real user

slides.say: To test a click or typing, use the user event library. It acts like a real person, not just a single event.
Call user event setup before rendering. Then await each action, like type and click.

slides.text: fireEvent dispatches ONE DOM event. user-event simulates the full interaction: focus, keys, input, click.
slides.say: The difference: fire event sends one DOM event. User event simulates the whole interaction, with focus, key presses, and input events, like a browser would.

slides.text: It also checks the element is usable: no clicking hidden elements, no typing into disabled boxes.
slides.say: It also checks what a user could actually do. It won't click a hidden element, or type into a disabled text box.
